_readme: The kie.ai model catalog + routing map. This is the single source of truth the 'director' (Claude) reads to pick a model and fill params, and that the adapter reads to build the actual HTTP request. Update this file when kie.ai adds/changes models — nothing else needs to change.

auth.note: Key is read from the KIE_API_KEY env var (server-side) or per-user BYOK storage. NEVER commit a key.

jobs.note: Unified async API for most models. Body = { "model": "<id>", "input": { ...model params } }. Response returns a taskId; poll until state is success/fail.

veo.note: Dedicated Veo route. Some Veo variants are also reachable through the unified jobs endpoint; prefer whichever the adapter has verified.

api.flow: 1) POST create -> get taskId.  2) Poll every ~3-5s until state == success (result urls) or fail.  3) Return media url(s).

_id_confidence: Fields marked "verify": true have model IDs/params confirmed against docs.kie.ai. Those marked false are best-effort from community docs and should be confirmed on first integration — the shape is right, the exact string may need a tweak.

models.label: Nano Banana
models.use_when: DEFAULT image model. Fast + cheap. Great for product/marketing shots, everyday scenes, and reference-based edits. Pick this unless a reason below overrides it.

image_urls.note: Reference or edit source images (hosted URLs).

models.label: Nano Banana Pro
models.use_when: Higher fidelity + 4K, and MUCH better at rendering legible text, logos, diagrams, and UI. Use when the image must contain readable words, fine typography, or needs 2K/4K crispness.

models.label: Seedream
models.use_when: Strong photoreal / cinematic aesthetic and portraits. Good alternative when Nano Banana output feels flat and you want more 'shot on camera' realism.

models.label: GPT Image (OpenAI 4o)
models.use_when: Best instruction-following for complex, multi-element compositions and precise edits with masks. Slower + pricier — use when layout precision matters more than speed.

models.label: Flux Kontext
models.use_when: Cheapest fast image path and solid at style transfer / consistent character edits across a series. Good for high-volume iteration.

models.label: Veo 3 Fast
models.use_when: DEFAULT video model. Google Veo 3, fast tier, with audio. Great quality-per-dollar for most social/ad clips. Pick this unless the user needs top-tier quality or a specific other model.

models.label: Veo 3 Quality
models.use_when: Top-tier Veo 3 quality with audio. Use when the user explicitly wants the best-looking result and cost is secondary (hero shots, final ad).

models.label: Sora 2
models.use_when: Strong physical realism, coherent motion, and storyboard-from-images mode. Use for narrative/cinematic sequences or when you want to drive a multi-image storyboard.

models.label: Seedance
models.use_when: Best identity/character consistency in motion and reliable image-to-video. Use when preserving a subject's look across the clip matters.

models.label: Kling
models.use_when: Smooth motion and good image-to-video animation of a single start frame. Solid general-purpose alternative to Veo Fast.

models.label: Suno
models.use_when: Music and song generation (with or without lyrics). Use for background tracks, jingles, or full songs.
